description: Turns MIDI messages into the binary signal that Expert Sleepers ESX-8GT hardware reads, giving MIDI the same sample-accurate timing as the audio interface.

outputs.text: Carries one MIDI port encoded as an audio-rate signal for an Expert Sleepers 8GT module; nothing else in a patch reads it.

notes: output is produced only at a sample rate of 48000Hz.
nothing is produced until Driver active is switched on and another MIDI module is set to send to one of these virtual ports.
menu: Driver active — switches on the MIDI-ESX driver, which other MIDI modules can then pick as their output device.
Port group A to Port group D — picks which set of virtual MIDI ports this module receives from.
MIDI Reset — Port 1 to Port 8 each send a reset on that port, and Reset all ports sends one on every port.
